title: Keyboard only QA pass
when: The user wants a page or app tested using only the keyboard: tab order, focus visibility, menus, dialogs and custom widgets.
prompt:
Goal: A full keyboard walk where every task is done without a mouse, each failure recorded with the element and the key.
Steps:
1. Start from the address bar and press Tab: a skip link appears first and jumps to main.
2. Tab through everything: order follows the visual order, focus always shows, nothing hidden or offscreen takes focus.
3. Operate: Enter on links and buttons, Space on buttons and checkboxes, arrows in radio groups, tabs, menus and sliders, Escape closes menus and dialogs.
4. Dialogs: focus moves inside on open, Tab cycles inside, Escape closes, focus returns to the opener.
5. Widgets: no keyboard trap (2.1.2); tabindex only 0 or -1, never positive.
6. Finish each main task (sign up, add to cart, play a level) by keyboard and note the number of key presses.
Quality bar:
- Each failure names element, key and result.
- Every main task attempted.
- Focus lost after DOM updates is reported.
Pitfalls:
- Clicking into the page first with a mouse.
- Missing focus dropped to body after a dialog closes.
- Ignoring menus that open on hover only.
Verify:
- [ ] Skip link checked.
- [ ] Tab order written down.
- [ ] Dialog focus handling checked.
- [ ] Main tasks passed or failed with notes.
Output: keyboard-qa.md with the tab order list and the failures.

examples.input: testa meu site so com o teclado
examples.output: tab order 14 stops, focus invisible on cards, Escape does not close the menu, checkout completed in 23 keys
